Name: Maacah, Daughter of Talmai
Summary: Maacah, daughter of Talmai king of Geshur, was David's wife and the mother of Absalom and Tamar.
KeyStory: Maacah's marriage joined David's house to Geshur — and her son nearly tore it apart.
RelatedPeople: King David; Absalom; Tamar, Daughter of David; Talmai, King of Geshur
LifeLesson: A royal marriage can plant both alliance and rebellion in one house.
